{{Quote|Someone must have told them about my little maneuver at the Battle of Taanab.|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Episode 6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
'''Taanab''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of green meadows in the [[Taanab system/Legends|Taanab system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories. It was primarily used for [[Agriworld/Legends|agriculture]] and [[Farm/Legends|farming]]. Its populace was known for always maintaining an air of formality. Taanab had problems with seasonal [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] raids from bandits striking from the planet [[Norulac]] for millennia prior to the [[Battle of Taanab/Legends|Battle of Taanab]].

Located on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] between [[Tirahnn/Legends|Tirahnn]] and [[Lantillies/Legends|Lantillies]], it served as a strategic port to the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] via a smaller [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]], which led through the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] as far away as [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]]. Due to its favourable position Taanab was known as a popular destination place and a growing commercial hub in the outer edges of the Inner Rim.

==Characteristics==
The [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] planet of Taanab was a world with abundant sunlight, mild climate, almost no tectonic activity with grassy landmasses, always close to meandering strips of water. The planet was overgrown with green jungles, but no animal life at the time of its colonization.<ref name="TEA" />

Near the equator, the fields and factory farms were formed into a hexagonal tessellation. Much of its climate was optimized for bumper yields by weather-controlling [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] and orbital mirrors.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Taanab-staga-swkids.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A herd of [[Ambria/Legends|Ambrian]] [[Staga/Legends|staga]] on the fields of Taanab.]]

The fauna was imported, with some becoming feral. The untamed former herd members had their numbers checked by [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooters]].<ref name="TEA" />

The administrative capital was [[Pandath/Legends|Pandath]]. Taanab was sponsored by agricultural conglomerates like [[Arcon Multinode Agricorp]], [[Tagge Restaurant Association/Legends|Tagge Restaurant Association]], and [[Core Foodstuffs]]. The [[Banthal Company]] transported cargo to poorer worlds.<ref name="TEA" />

The planet was especially known for its [[Roba steak/Legends|roba steak]].

==History==
The planet was first discovered between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] to [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]], sometime between the [[Tionese War]] and the settling of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a [[Battle of the Taanab system|battle]] was fought here during the [[Krath Holy Crusade]] which the [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith]] had won.<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], an extremely rare and young [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] was spotted on the planet and pursued for research purposes.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Securing a Sarlacc}}</ref>

It was later colonized in [[2320 BBY/Legends|2320 BBY]], when Taanab was once a world covered in thick, inhospitable jungle, similar to [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. During the [[New Sith Wars]], the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] [[Battle of Taanab (New Sith Wars)|captured]] the planet and used it as an outpost. Eventually the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] established a [[Jedi chapter house (Taanab)/Legends|chapter house]] for the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] in the capital city of [[Pandath/Legends|Pandath]]<ref name="TEA" /> and Taanab became the site of the Inner Rim headquarters of the AgriCorps.<ref name="JP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

[[File:Taanab_people.png|thumb|left|200px|A Taanab fleet [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] (left) and wealthy patron (right).]]

[[Huff Darklighter]] once employed farmers from Taanab, as well as [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]] and [[Salliche/Legends|Salliche]], to staff his underground hydroponic gardens on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

The [[Battle of Taanab/Legends|Battle of Taanab]] took place over its skies five months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. In the battle, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] defeated attacking [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] raiders from [[Norulac]] against the [[Banthal Company]] [[Banthal Company Docks|docks]].<ref name="TEA" />

Taanab joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] sometime prior to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. It was a New Republic stronghold during the [[Hunt for Zsinj]].<ref name="TEA" /> The planet was [[Taanab operation|attacked]] by Imperial forces during the [[Thrawn campaign]]. During the attack, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Joruus C'baoth]] took control of the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Bellicose (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Bellicose'']] and used the ship's [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] to destroy a New Republic ship against the orders of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Aban]].<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>

Years later, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]] [[Mission to Taanab|went]] to Taanab to discover more about the operations going on in [[Taanab Spaceport|its spaceport]] by the [[Disciples of Ragnos]]. Jaden battled a [[Taanab mutant rancor|mutant rancor]] which the Disciples intended to release in a populated place so they could pillage the area during the chaos.<ref name="JA" />

[[File:Taanab_JP.jpg|left|thumb|A denta field on Taanab.]]
Taanab became a New Republic, and later [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], stronghold during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] and was not attacked by the [[Yuuzhan Vong|invaders]].<ref name="TEA" /> A native of Taanab, [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] veteran [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] created the [[Taanab Yellow Aces]] during the Yuuzhan Vong War and named it after the world.<ref name="EL2:RS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>

In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Ben Skywalker]] traveled to Taanab space during his pursuit of [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|''Ship'']].<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> In [[44 ABY]], a royal [[Hapan]] fleet transporting [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|refugees]] from the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] halted at some point above Taanab. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] left the ''[[Dragon Queen II]]'' there to join the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|liberation of Coruscant]].<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]'', the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Tales of the Jedi'']], and [[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy|''Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy'']], the planet is misspelled '''Tanaab'''. Also, in ''[[Star Wars Omnibus: X-Wing Rogue Squadron Volume 2]]'', Taanab is misspelled '''Taanad'''.

Additionally, [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Taanab in Farfin sector, a misspelling of the true [[Farrfin sector/Legends|Farrfin sector]], within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

During the development of the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', the developers apparently considered using Taanab as one of the planets that can be explored by players in the game. The creation of the planet was canceled for unknown reasons, however some files of the released game still contain textures and other data relating to what was to be Taanab.
